genericProblem: A UI package can retain a valid prewrite snapshot while its physical screens drift from accepted IA, owner facts, foundation contracts, or catalog references; it can also spend disproportionate time on generic preparation and then make point fixes without a per-change source reread and post-change IA review. A written reread/process rule is not itself evidence that the author applied it to a later remediation batch.
finiteDenominator: 38 accepted physical screens / 36 actual platform-admin consumers for the source-to-IA conformance baseline
searchQueries: generated operation-id literal in focused test
counterexamples: PlatformApp menu labels already derive from platformPageRegistry and must not be rewritten.
Drawer and field copy without a corresponding semantic catalog node is not a PAGE-title catalog bypass.
Generated RTK invalidation is a valid refresh mechanism even when a component has no explicit refetch call.
A read-only source inspection is not an actual implementation change point, but it remains required evidence before a later write.
A single aggregate test command can prove the suite outcome but cannot replace each changed test's IA/consumer/design reread.
